procedures.assessment: Public context/export identity remains distinct from a runnable backend; unknown extraction and source-surface obligations are not closed.
procedures.rejecting_example: Fresh identity on each access, reused identity after replacement, private-only export.

procedures.assessment: Create resolves with local visibility and write access; duplicates, absent open, and absent stat are distinct. Cross-process pre-materialization visibility is not required.
procedures.rejecting_example: Upsert, phantom absent session, delayed local visibility.

procedures.assessment: Logical immutable header and exact inherited cut remain separate from replay events. Seeded explicit zero is legal; missing/negative/fractional cuts and unseeded nonzero are refused. Parent length equality is not invented.
procedures.rejecting_example: Alias mutation, silently replacing the cut with current event count, injected metadata event.

procedures.assessment: Native writer competition and read coexistence/read-only mutation need actual backend evidence. Read-write access is preserved.
procedures.rejecting_example: Two successful writers, reader displacing writer, read-handle append/flush.

procedures.assessment: Lost ownership never implicitly resurrects a handle. Export construction is separate from currently unqualified native-loss availability.
procedures.rejecting_example: Stale handle reacquiring ownership or writing after loss; a synthetic thrown error cannot prove fencing.

procedures.assessment: Exact ordered contiguous continuation starts at stored next-seq and retains original prefix/payloads.
procedures.rejecting_example: Sort, drop, overwrite, gap acceptance, duplicate/old seq acceptance.

procedures.assessment: Single original-property capture and delayed mutation are independent. Plain own-enumerable local getter admission is supported by the listed walk closure; it is not inferred from JSON transport.
procedures.rejecting_example: Two synchronous original traversals read twice/capture B; delayed alias mutation changes stored data; lossy JSON accepted.

procedures.assessment: Default read is arguments []; slices are positional. Outer array belongs to caller. Detached ownership and actual shared aliases differ; shared-frozen can contain independently owned unfrozen values, including empty producer-state slices.
procedures.rejecting_example: Shared mutable outer array/value, false detached declaration, off-by-one slice.

procedures.assessment: Actual append/flush completion precedes read start on the same instance. Concurrent read only promises a contiguous prefix; same-handle progress does not backtrack.
procedures.rejecting_example: Stale post-barrier cache or backward observation; timestamps alone cannot prove happens-before.

procedures.assessment: Resolved flush makes empty metadata and accepted prefix durable across abrupt process loss. Eager append is legal and unflushed loss is not required.
procedures.rejecting_example: Flush acknowledgment with only memory state; same-process recreation/graceful teardown is insufficient.

procedures.assessment: Four independent fresh live fixtures separate close-only and sole async-disposal writers/readers. Drain, ownership/resources, closed refusal, idempotence and uncancellability are observed before fallback cleanup.
procedures.rejecting_example: No-op disposal with correct close, retained ownership/resources, lost accepted data, post-close operations.

procedures.assessment: Global flush captures all active writers, excludes readers, continues after failure, names failed sessions, and accounts for concurrent close.
procedures.rejecting_example: Fail-fast skips B, generic unnamed failure, read-handle flush.

procedures.assessment: Independent reads prove H1 differs from H0 after actual append+flush; equality across same-instance/session metadata must not license old-body cache reuse. Separate ownership-only churn leaves revision unchanged. No token order or unequal-implies-change is imposed.
procedures.rejecting_example: Constant token with otherwise correct data; phantom/duplicate list entries, full-body metadata IO, ownership mutation, byte/count conflation.

procedures.assessment: Pre-work cancellation covers each signal-bearing operation, with actual IO/mutation counters. Later abort rollback is unspecified and teardown stays uncancellable.
procedures.rejecting_example: Pre-aborted signal ignored; synthetic AbortError hides prior storage effects.

procedures.assessment: Unsupported current logical version/vocabulary and corruption remain distinguishable. Optional unknown ignorable data follows actual adoption; raw diagnostic location is conditional. Historical physical migration remains excluded rather than assumed equivalent.
procedures.rejecting_example: Required unknown event skipped, unsupported relabeled corrupt, destructive refusal, format renumbering.

procedures.assessment: Public helper behavior and actual route wiring are separate obligations. Identity mismatch, JSON invalidity, version/vocabulary and continuity cannot be satisfied by a public name alone.
procedures.rejecting_example: Correct isolated validator bypassed by actual storage route; accept-everything shim.

procedures.assessment: Public names/categories, addressed session, optional resource location and cause survive a declared future projection. Native ownership loss is still unqualified.
procedures.rejecting_example: Owned collapsed into absent; unsupported into corrupt; session context/cause lost; diagnostic path becomes read authority.

procedures.assessment: A physical torn tail is never an event and continuation preserves the committed prefix. Real transactional atomicity/rollback is a distinct equivalent obligation, not an invented JSONL representation.
procedures.rejecting_example: Partial event returned, committed prefix rewritten/duplicated, acknowledged durable event lost; mocked error is insufficient.

literal_vectors.base: Header format4, synthetic IDs, bounded createdAt, owned absolute cwd binding; seq0..3 turn boundaries match listed types. This is not runtime admission evidence.
literal_vectors.reads: READ-DEFAULT uses the exact empty argument list; [1,2] returns seq1,2; [4,2] and [9,2] return empty. No JSON null/undefined conversion.
literal_vectors.cuts: Seeded explicit 0/1/2, missing/-1/1.5 negatives; unseeded omitted/0 versus nonzero; no parent-length equation.
literal_vectors.getter: Header agentPreset A then B and event.data.turn 0 then1; one local original read, first-value capture. No execution, IPC serialization or arbitrary-code witness.
literal_vectors.continuity: At next-seq4: [5], [5,4], [1] are negative; exact payload/order preservation forbids normalization.
literal_vectors.identity_time_format: Requested S/stored T, createdAt -1 and 9007199254740992, logical versions5 and3, required versus explicitly ignorable unknown vocabulary are separate cases.
literal_vectors.non_json: Fixed local cycle/function/undefined are constructed only in a future owned fixture; no null rejection is invented.
literal_vectors.teardown_revision: Fresh A/B/C/D sole-teardown cases and changed-body versus ownership-only revision fixtures remain independent.
literal_vectors.unqualified_closure: Native backend/build, full adoption/codec closure, exact physical raw fixtures and CVG lossless bridge are not admitted by this documentary review. Unknown ignorable adoption is explicitly deferred. A lower logical-version helper refusal is not a blanket refusal of historically supported physical generations.

current_gap_assessment: G01-G13 are source-supported static differences, not measured runtime failures. No public bridge is implemented or authorized.

cvg_sources.assessment: Current format1 public openSession/append/read envelope lacks matching handle/header/flush/stat/list/identity/revision/signal contract.
Synthetic process-local store, idempotent open, per-event append/dedup, one-based and afterSequence-exclusive read.
Closed error/schema envelope and accessor-refusing value admission are differences requiring an approved bridge, not silent relaxation.
Tenant-bound transaction per append is a static lead only. Native durability and protocol equivalence were not measured.
Documented current export surfaces and separate217 composition do not close session-handle parity.
